# ITAM maturity checklist

1. Scope agreed: which estates, business units, and asset types [[XW-003]]
2. Answers and one evidence item collected per process area [[XW-025]]
3. Scores challenged against evidence; changes explained [[XW-025]]
4. Check that license counts are backed by proofs of purchase kept as long as the records schedule requires, using `sam-toolkit/proof-of-purchase-check.csv`; lower the score where proofs are missing [[XW-006]] [[XW-007]]
5. Check that an acquisition gate is in use and no purchase bypasses it [[XW-009]] [[XW-027]]
6. Check that invoices are reviewed against the contract before payment [[XW-012]] [[XW-013]]
7. Check that an audit response plan exists and was tested, for example by a dry run [[XW-004]] [[XW-020]]
8. Each area mapped to its crosswalk rows [[XW-003]]
9. Three gaps named with tie-break reasoning [[XW-025]]
10. 90-day plan drafted with owner roles and proof of progress [[XW-004]]
11. Owners and budget confirmed by the sponsor [[XW-004]]
12. Assessment filed with date for next year's comparison [[XW-020]]
